name: mint-iter-besu-probe
description: ItWorksinMyLocal#62 besu S2-follow probe: same 3-oldxdc-sealer trusted quorum as mint-iter.json, but instead of a role=proposer candidate (topo.sh hard-rejects role=proposer for client besu -- no sealing-flag path wired), besu is joined here as a plain role=follower node ('besu1') to answer one narrow question honestly: can the currently-staged besu binary (bin/besu, the tar.gz whose sha256 is 7ade4f2f... -- the 'good' build per the besu-xdc-5551 memory, NOT the broken 246e5030 build published at xdc.network today) even sync/follow (S2) this genesis, before any sealing question is reachable at all. Separate portBase (34700) from mint-iter.json's own (34500) so the two topologies never collide if brought up concurrently.
